binding_semantics.policy: bindings are distinct unless an explicit registered equivalence class says otherwise

activation.definition: a candidate law produces at least one effective committed write in a registered arm

behavioral_inertness.definition: paired candidate-present minus candidate-absent execution has neither a committed observed-state difference nor additional normalized world-law activity

realized_dependency_depth.definition: longest candidate-rooted path through additional world-law occurrences connected by ordered last-effective committed-write/read dependencies

necessity_backed_depth.definition: longest realized dependency path retaining world-to-world edges only when single-law ablation reduces the downstream normalized semantic occurrence count
necessity_backed_depth.interpretation: conservative lower bound, not general actual causality

depth_gap.interpretation: diagnostic compatible with redundancy, overdetermination, or another non-necessary realized dependency; not proof of redundant causation

outcome_differentiation.definition: inequality among environment-specific paired net observed-state effects
outcome_differentiation.design: candidate-present minus candidate-absent, then compare environments

causal_path_differentiation.definition: inequality among environment-specific multisets of normalized candidate-induced world-law path signatures

deprecated.environmentally_differentiated: v0.4 compatibility only; forbidden as a v0.5 headline

structural_evidence.exact_match: fingerprint identity against one or more of the 36 registered references; exact non-match is weak evidence only
structural_evidence.near_copy: explicit unweighted one-point edit profile against the nearest registered reference
structural_evidence.recombination: conservative evidence that candidate structural terms are covered by the union of at most two registered references; false is not proof of non-recombination
structural_evidence.semantic_structure: field identity participates in read/write structure
structural_evidence.abstract_topology: canonical field renaming removes field identity while preserving read/write relation, operators, polarity, temporal form, scope, cardinality, and dependency topology

limitations.general_causality: not solved; single-law necessity ablation is intentionally a lower bound
limitations.recombination: only conservative exact structural-term coverage by at most two references
limitations.equivalent_bindings: no inferred equivalence; only explicit future registration
limitations.dead_code: only registered static boundary guards plus paired runtime behavior; no general SAT or symbolic execution
